visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young girl standing indoors; she has short brown hair and wears a shiny pink satin dress with black sleeves and cat-ear headbands. She holds a white star wand with a focused facial expression while standing in front of household storage bins. (2) The scene transitions to the girl sitting on a weathered wooden bench in an outdoor park setting with green bushes behind her. She is dressed in a different pink and white ruffled outfit with a large red bow, looking slightly confused with her mouth open as people walk by in the distant background. (3) In an indoor workspace, a woman's hands with white nail polish are seen using large silver scissors to carefully cut a piece of smooth pink fabric laid out on a light-colored table surrounded by various cardboard boxes and equipment. (4) The woman sits at a white electronic sewing machine, guiding a piece of pink fabric through the needle while the young girl stands next to her, leaning in close with intense curiosity to observe the mechanical movement of the thread. (5) Multiple close-up shots emphasize the sewing machine's needle rapidly piercing through layers of white satin and pink fabric, creating neat seams. The woman's fingers are visible guiding the delicate material under the bright localized lighting of the machine. (6) A completed miniature tiered skirt with alternating layers of white ruffles and pink underskirts is displayed on a cream-colored child-sized dress form, showcasing the intricate sewing work against a plain indoor background. (7) The woman is shown painting a small white foam star with metallic gold paint using a thin brush, then applying liquid glue to a pink circular base with white wing-like attachments to assemble the iconic star wand. (8) The final phase reveals the girl in a brightly lit modern living room, wearing a full Cardcaptor Sakura cosplay outfit including a wig with bows. She spins around joyfully, laughing and pointing the star wand towards the camera as she shows off the finished costume.
